description: This file defines the DisplayManager class for managing display and editing of models in OrchardCore, including methods for building display and editor shapes, updating editors, and invoking display drivers.

classes.name: DisplayManager<TModel>
classes.description: A generic class responsible for managing display and editing shapes for models, utilizing display drivers, shape factory, layout accessor, and logger.

methods.name: BuildDisplayAsync
methods.description: Builds a display shape for a given model, invoking display drivers and applying results.

methods.name: BuildEditorAsync
methods.description: Builds an editor shape for a given model, invoking display drivers and applying results.

methods.name: UpdateEditorAsync
methods.description: Updates an editor shape for a given model, invoking display drivers and applying results.
